name: Three glitch lines
what: Three lines of text stacked down a dark frame start as blocky glitch bars and clear into clean glowing text one after the other, fifteen frames apart, while the whole block drifts, squashes flat for a moment and swings back, then breathes a little sideways until the last frame.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f5 the block moves up and right (decelerating); f15 line 1 clears from its glitch bar into clean text, f30 line 2, f45 line 3; f18-f25 it swings right, f25-f41 over to the left while it is squashed flat (down to 66 % at f40-f41), f41-f60 it comes back and rises to full height and home; then it breathes a little sideways (about 2 %) until the last frame, which is empty
